instructions: Read the entire Office Open XML Technical Reference for PowerPoint document before starting.
Ensure element ordering in `<p:txBody>` follows the sequence: `<a:bodyPr>`, `<a:lstStyle>`, `<a:p>`.
Add `xml:space='preserve'` to `<a:t>` elements that contain leading or trailing spaces.
Escape unicode characters in ASCII content, for example convert `"` to `“`.
Add images to `ppt/media/`, reference them in slide XML, and set their dimensions to fit slide bounds.
Update `ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels` for each slide's resources.
Add `dirty="0"` to `<a:rPr>` and `<a:endParaRPr>` elements to indicate a clean state.
When creating a text box or shape with text, use the provided XML structure with `<p:sp>`, including `<p:nvSpPr>`, `<p:spPr>`, and `<p:txBody>` elements.
When formatting text, use the provided XML examples for bold, italic, underline, highlight, font, size, and color.
When creating lists, use `<a:buChar>` for bullet lists and `<a:buAutoNum>` for numbered lists, and set the `lvl` attribute for indentation.
When creating shapes, use the provided XML examples for rectangle, rounded rectangle, and circle/ellipse, including `<a:prstGeom>` with appropriate `prst` values.
When adding images, use the provided XML structure for `<p:pic>`, including `<p:blipFill>` with `r:embed` referencing the image relationship ID.
When creating tables, use the provided XML structure for `<p:graphicFrame>` with `<a:tbl>`, including `<a:tblGrid>` and `<a:tr>` elements.
When using slide layouts, use the provided XML examples for title slide and content slide layouts, with appropriate `<p:ph>` types.
When adding content, update the following files: `ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels`, `ppt/slides/_rels/slide1.xml.rels`, `[Content_Types].xml`, `ppt/presentation.xml`, and `docProps/app.xml`.

When adding a new slide to the end of the presentation, create the slide file `ppt/slides/slideN.xml`, update `[Content_Types].xml` with an Override for the new slide, update `ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels` with a relationship for the new slide, update `ppt/presentation.xml` by adding a slide ID to `<p:sldIdLst>`, create slide relationships in `ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels` if needed, and update `docProps/app.xml` by incrementing the slide count and updating statistics if present.

When duplicating a slide, copy the source slide XML file with a new name, update all IDs in the new slide to be unique, follow the 'Adding a New Slide' steps, remove or update any notes slide references in `_rels` files, and remove references to unused media files.
When reordering slides, update `ppt/presentation.xml` by reordering `<p:sldId>` elements in `<p:sldIdLst>`, keeping slide IDs and relationship IDs unchanged.

When deleting a slide, remove the `<p:sldId>` entry from `ppt/presentation.xml`, delete the relationship from `ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels`, delete the Override entry from `[Content_Types].xml`, delete the files `ppt/slides/slideN.xml` and `ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels`, update `docProps/app.xml` by decrementing the slide count and updating statistics, and clean up unused media by removing orphaned images from `ppt/media/`.
Do not renumber remaining slides after deletion; keep their original IDs and filenames.

Avoid common errors: escape unicode characters in ASCII content, add images to `ppt/media/` and update relationship files, omit bullets from list headers, use valid hexadecimal values for UUIDs, and check all themes in the `theme` directory for colors.
Before packing, clean unused resources by removing unreferenced media, fonts, and notes directories.
Fix `Content_Types.xml` to declare ALL slides, layouts, and themes present in the package.
Fix relationship IDs by removing font embed references if not using embedded fonts.
Remove broken references by checking all `_rels` files for references to deleted resources.

Avoid common template duplication pitfalls: ensure multiple slides do not reference the same notes slide after duplication, remove image/media references from template slides that no longer exist, remove font embedding references when fonts aren't included, add missing slideLayout declarations for layouts 12-25, and note that the docProps directory may not unpack and is optional.
